## MC Hoster 1.2.0

**Download `MC-Hoster.exe` below** and double-click it.

### New
- **Up to 1500 players**: more than 100 asks 2 times, more than 500 asks 5 times, more than 1000 asks 7 times. Saying no goes back to the last number you confirmed.
- **Vault** plugin in tab 5 (Plugins & Mods): the economy/permissions link that shop and money plugins need.
